objective: One simple VP-Bench with strongest reference accuracy below90%, preferably85–89%, supporting later post-training. First pursue exact4D; compare no-dhatu tense modification as alternative.

contracts.creation: Dictionary dhatu plus lakara/prayoga/purusha/vacana → one accepted Devanagari form.
contracts.modification: Source Devanagari form +source fourcoordinates +target fourcoordinates → one accepted Devanagari form. NO dhatu, class, meaning or derivation recipe visible. Change lakara only in pilot.

selection: Freeze complete panels before answers; no accuracy stopping or failure-based item selection. Selected inputs only development; same-target paired controls for modification.
ambiguity: Inverse audit source-form+coordinates across declared audited dictionary inventory; exclude ambiguity or require all analyses agree on full target union. Disclose bounded lexical scope.
remaining_requirements: Minimum500 unique final tasks, prefer1000+, independent final evaluation/training, retained samplingSE<1pp requirement; discoverypilots do not qualify final benchmarks.
